predictor: Average mean + average-reference kernel, PCA32/width64/24 iterations. Three fresh members, each 4000 updates. Frozen during PPO.
split: Existing global linked-series/document/molecule outer folds. Outer training groups split approximately half predictor / half PPO. All outer validation groups used for model checkpoint selection; test never used for selection.
mean_sd: Mean and total mixture SD in endpoint-standardized initial-hit-relative coordinates. Raw predictive variance, no post-hoc temperature.
latent: Mean of pair encoder hidden features over all acquired references for each of three predictor members; concatenate 3x64 coordinates; LayerNorm192 -> learned linear projection to d -> tanh.
actor: Pointwise FFN: (2+d) ->64 tanh ->64 tanh ->1. No pooling, attention, EI, incumbent, progress, or raw molecular features in actor.
critic: Separate common critic sees pooled mean/SD and remaining count; no latent features. Critic is discarded at deployment.
objective: Undiscounted -1 reward for each purchase until any tied global optimum is acquired. PPO clipped surrogate; full episode Monte Carlo returns.
initialization: Fresh random actor and projection, no imitation/pretraining. Predictor also refitted from scratch on its disjoint subset.
selection: Minimum validation top1 purchases / exact random expectation: half all validation pools, half >=15. Checks100/200/300/400; no step0 candidate.
evaluation: K=1; four fixed worst-half starting hits; deterministic highest score; purchases to any top1/top2/top3/top4, initial hit free and ties included.
primary: >=15 pools; endpoint-balanced pooled metrics and linked-group paired bootstrap. All eligible >=3 pools also reported.
scope: Controlled feature ablation with fixed PPO hyperparameters. Species pooled within each endpoint.
